source_question.title: Most Major Pro Sports Teams (NBA + NFL + MLB + NHL)
source_question.prompt: Rank the US states by combined number of franchises across the four major pro leagues (NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL).

source.name: Official league franchise directories (NBA.com, NFL.com, MLB.com, NHL.com)

source_question.note: Counts include only US-based franchises. California hosts LA Lakers, LA Clippers, GS Warriors, Sacramento Kings, LA Rams, LA Chargers, SF 49ers, LA Dodgers, SF Giants, LA/Anaheim Angels, Oakland A's (before Vegas move), Anaheim Ducks, LA Kings, SJ Sharks. New York includes both NY-metro NBA/NHL/NFL/MLB teams (Knicks, Nets, Rangers, Islanders, Sabres, Giants, Jets, Bills, Yankees, Mets).
source_question.disclaimer: Counts include only US-based franchises. Includes Washington DC.
source_question.trivia: California hosts LA Lakers, LA Clippers, GS Warriors, Sacramento Kings, LA Rams, LA Chargers, SF 49ers, LA Dodgers, SF Giants, LA/Anaheim Angels, Oakland A's (before Vegas move), Anaheim Ducks, LA Kings, SJ Sharks. New York includes both NY-metro NBA/NHL/NFL/MLB teams (Knicks, Nets, Rangers, Islanders, Sabres, Giants, Jets, Bills, Yankees, Mets).

note: List covers 28 states; an inverse 'Fewest major pro sports teams' ranking would be interesting for the many states with zero teams.
